EduPlay Studio sincerely expresses its gratitude to the individuals, communities, and organizations whose work, ideas, and contributions have directly or indirectly supported the development of this project.

We would like to thank:
• Kenney (Kenney Vleugels) for providing high-quality, free game assets that greatly support educational and indie game development.
• Sefton Kimberley Downes for the Who Wants to Be a Millionaire (WWBM) project, which served as a valuable technical and conceptual reference in the study of quiz-based game mechanics.
• The open-source community for sharing knowledge, tools, and resources that make learning and software development more accessible to everyone.

We also acknowledge the authors, researchers, and designers whose work has shaped the educational and design philosophy behind EduPlay Studio, including:
• James Paul Gee
• Karl Kapp
• Contributors to Bloom’s Taxonomy
• Don Norman

Additionally, we appreciate the inspiration drawn from existing educational and creative platforms such as Scratch, Construct, GDevelop, Wordwall, Kahoot, and Quizizz, which demonstrate effective ways to simplify complex processes for learners.

help.content:
NOTE: All games you create are called projects.

1) OVERVIEW / CREATE PROJECT (MANUAL)
- On the Home screen:
  - NEW: create a new project
  - EDIT: open and edit an existing project
  - PLAY: preview / view results
- Create a new project:
  1. Click NEW
  2. Enter name and description
  3. Choose game type (Classic Quiz / Who Wants to Be a Millionaire / Fishing)
  4. Click Create & Edit
- In the editor:
  - Add questions, answers, images/audio
  - Save often

2) EDIT WITH AI (EDUBOT)
- Before using AI: configure GROQ_API_KEY (or EDUPLAY_GROQ_API_KEY).
- Open Edubot via the floating chat button.
- Example prompts:
  - Create 10 grade-3 math questions about multiplication
  - Rewrite 5 questions to be easier to understand
  - Generate answers and short explanations
- After AI generates questions: drag/drop or add to the project and refine if needed.

3) INSTALL ADD-IN & INSERT GAME INTO POWERPOINT
- Install add-in:
  1. Open EduPlay Studio → Settings → Add-in → Install / Repair Add-in
  2. Accept Admin permission (if prompted)
  3. Close and reopen PowerPoint
  4. Open the EduPlay Add-in in PowerPoint
- Insert game into PPT:
  1. In EduPlay Studio: export the game as single-file HTML
  2. In PowerPoint: open the EduPlay Add-in
  3. In the add-in: select HTML file → import/insert → save into the PPT
  4. If needed: insert a placeholder to show the embedded viewer on the slide
- When playing in the slide viewer:
  - Mouse/keyboard focus stays inside the game frame and won't auto-advance slides
  - Press →/↓ for next slide, ←/↑ for previous slide
  - Or click outside the frame and change slides normally

help.sections.advanced.content:
⚙️ Advanced — exam mode, shuffle & EXE

Fine-tune how the game plays and how you ship it.

🎛️ Game rules
– Exam / practice mode: editor → left panel → Game config → choose once (real test) or retry allowed (practice). Or tell Edubot: “enable exam mode”.
– Shuffle: turn on randomize questions so every play has a different order.
– Time & points: set time per question (5–300 s) and points per correct answer, e.g. “set time to 45 seconds”.
– Backup: tell Edubot “backup project” to keep a .eduplay file for another PC (open it with Import project in Browse).
–
help.sections.advanced.title: Advanced
help.sections.best_practices.content:
🌟 Best practices

Small habits that make your games much better.

✍️ Writing
– Short names: e.g. Math 4 - Fractions, easy to find in Browse.
– 5–15 questions per game: split longer lessons into 2–3 games.
– Always add explanations: 1–2 lines on why the answer is right help students remember.
🖼️ Media & testing
– Add images where they help (diagrams, animals…): middle panel → Choose image, or ask Edubot “add an image to question 3”.
– Always Preview (blue button on top) before sharing: check answers, spelling, images.
– Mind the link expiry: web links last about 15 days — share close to test day.
help.sections.best_practices.title: Best practices
help.sections.create_project.content:
📁 Create a Project

All games you create are called projects.

✨ Step 1 - Create
– Home screen → click CREATE NEW
– enter name & description
– choose a game type
– click Create & Edit
✏️ Step 2 - Edit questions
– Click + Add question
– Choose question type (multiple choice, true/false, fill-in...)
– Fill question/options/explanations
– Attach images/audio if needed
– Use Import to import from DOCX/Excel
🚀 Step 3 - Preview & Save
– Use Preview in the editor
– Use Play on the home screen for full-screen mode
– Save frequently (auto-save is on)
✨ New features
Unique names per machine: you cannot create two projects with the same name (case-insensitive). Renaming to a taken name is refused; duplicates/imports auto-number as Name (2).
Undo: the ↩ ↪ buttons in the editor header or Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y — undo add/edit/delete/duplicate, plus renames and game-config edits (up to 30 steps).
Auto backup: every save keeps 5 timestamped backups in the project's backups folder. A corrupted file is auto-restored from the newest backup with a notice.

help.sections.edubot.content:
🤖 Edubot — 50+ jobs AI assistant

Talk naturally like texting; Edubot does the work. Chat button 💬 purple bottom-right, draggable. Auto-replies in your chat language.

⚡ How to use
1. Open a project (CREATE NEW or Browse → Open).
2. Click 💬.
3. Examples:
— “Create 5 quiz questions about grade-4 fractions”
— “Delete the last 2” or “Change question 3 to …”
— “Set time per question to 45 seconds” • “Calculate 12*8+5” • “App info”
Ask “what can you do” for all 50+ jobs.
📎 From your files
1. Click the paperclip 📎 → choose Word, Excel or image.
2. Type “Create questions from this document/image”.
3. Edubot only uses your file content, never invents extra.
Tip: combine jobs in one sentence, e.g. “Create 5 fraction questions, enable shuffle, set 45s”.
🧠 Edubot memory
Edubot has two memories:
— Long-term: only your traits (name, age, subjects, likes, style...), concise, never what you did.
— Per session: your last 5 messages (AI replies excluded) to understand follow-ups like “delete question 2”.
— Each app close ends a session: Edubot summarizes your 5 messages into long-term memory first, then clears the session.
— To forget everything, tell Edubot: “clear memory”.

help.sections.faq.content:
❓ FAQ

Quick answers to the most common questions.

💡 General
1. Internet needed? No — everything works offline, only Edubot and web links need internet.
2. Where are projects saved? In Documents/EduPlay. Backup with Edubot: “backup project”.
3. Must students install anything? No — open the .html or tap the link and play.
🔗 Links & slides
4. How long do web links last? About 15 days. Republish the same project for a fresh link (overwrites the old one).
5. How to play inside PowerPoint? During slideshow, click inside the frame to play; click outside then arrows to change slides.
6. Deleted by accident? Deleted questions/projects cannot be restored — Duplicate before big edits.
7. Need more help? Ask Edubot (💬 button) or email support@eduplay-studio.io.vn, web https://eduplay-studio.io.vn.
help.sections.faq.title: FAQ
help.sections.interface.content:
🖥️ Interface

EduPlay Studio is built around a simple home screen and a left toolbar.

🏠 Home screen
– Create: start a new learning project.
– Edit: open and continue a saved project.
– Play: test or publish the game you created.
🧰 Left toolbar
Hover near the left edge of the window to open the toolbar. It contains quick links to Home, Projects, Preview and Quick Actions.
⚙️ Top-right buttons
– ? opens this help guide.
– ⚙ opens Settings (language, theme, AI, add-in).
The 💬 button in the bottom-right corner opens Edubot.

help.sections.keyboard_shortcuts.content:
⌨️ Keyboard shortcuts

Work twice as fast with a few keys.

⌨️ Keys
Ctrl+K — Quick find: type open project / create / preview / export → Enter.
Ctrl+T — Quick calculator: type expression (x for *, : for /) → Enter.
Ctrl+Z — Undo the last edit; Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z — Redo.
F5 / Shift+F5 — PowerPoint keys (not app keys): F5 plays from the start, Shift+F5 from the current slide.
— slideshow from start; Shift+F5 — from current slide.
🖱️ Mouse tips
Hover the very left edge to open the side menu. The purple 💬 chat button can be dragged anywhere.

help.sections.overview.content:
🧭 Overview

EduPlay Studio helps teachers create fun learning games, preview them instantly, and embed them into PowerPoint — all offline.

📚 Terms
– Project: a lesson/game you create (questions, settings, assets).
– Game type: Classic Quiz / Millionaire / Fishing.
– Preview: quick test inside the app.
– Play: full-screen play mode.
– Export: produce an output to share or embed elsewhere.
🧩 Components
– EduPlay Studio: create and manage projects.
– Edubot: AI assistant to generate/edit questions.
– PowerPoint Add-in: insert EduPlay games into PowerPoint slides.
💡 Tip
Works fully offline; only Edubot needs an AI connection (configurable in Settings).
✨ What’s new
— Web links: publishing shows a confirmation panel first; links last ~15 days and auto-renew when you open the app; manage them in Browse projects → Links.
— Safety: unique project names per machine; Ctrl+Z undo for everything; corrupted files auto-restore from backup.
— Edubot remembers your traits per session (see Edubot section).
help.sections.overview.subtitle: Quick intro & terminology
help.sections.overview.title: Overview
help.sections.performance.content:
🚀 Performance — keep it smooth

EduPlay runs offline so it is fast by default. If opening is slow, do this.

🛠️ Tips
1. Slim images: keep each under 1MB — crop big screenshots before attaching.
2. Slim games: over 50 questions? Split into 2–3 smaller games.
3. Close heavy apps while exporting or full-previewing.
4. Restart the app if it feels slow after a long session — saved projects are safe.
help.sections.performance.title: Performance
help.sections.powerpoint_addin.content:
📊 PowerPoint Add-in

This feature lets you insert EduPlay games into PowerPoint slides for classroom use.

📥 Installation
1. Settings → Add-in tab → click Install / Repair Add-in
2. Accept Administrator permission if asked
3. Close and reopen PowerPoint
4. Find the EduPlay button on the ribbon (under Add-ins)
🧩 How to use
1. Open the EduPlay Add-in in PowerPoint
2. Select your project in EduPlay Studio
3. Click Insert Game to insert into the slide
🎮 Playing on slides
– Interactions stay inside the game frame; it won't auto-advance slides.
– To change slides from inside the frame: press →/↓ (next), ←/↑ (previous).
– Or click outside the frame and use arrow keys normally.
❓ Can't find the EduPlay button?
– Go back to Settings → Add-in → click Install / Repair Add-in again.
– Close/reopen PowerPoint.
– PowerPoint: File → Options → Add-ins → Manage: COM Add-ins → make sure EduPlay is enabled.
– Restart your PC if still missing.

help.sections.powerpoint_addin.title: PowerPoint Add-in
help.sections.preview_export.content:
🚀 Preview & Export

Test your game inside EduPlay Studio, then share it with students.

👀 Preview
– In the editor, use Preview to see how the game looks while you edit.
– From the left toolbar, open Preview to test the current project.
– From the home screen, Play runs the game full-screen.
🎛️ Export modes
– Student mode: one attempt, final score is shown at the end.
– Teaching mode: retry allowed, answers can be revealed — great for live explanation.
🔗 Share your game — 2 ways
– Single-file HTML (plays offline): in the editor, top-right, click the orange Export internal (HTML) → choose a folder → Save → you get 1 .html file (questions, images, sounds included). Send it via Zalo/Email/class group; students open it in Chrome and play right away, no install needed.
– Web link (tap to play): in the editor, click the blue Publish to web → wait until it finishes (Publishing...). The Game Links window appears: next to Public play link: click Copy (or Open in browser to test it yourself). Send the link via Zalo/Email/class group; students tap and play on phone/computer (internet required).
— Before uploading, a confirmation panel shows the name, question count, size, the link to use and the status (overwrite old link / create new link / name taken by another machine, separate link). Click Publish to upload, Cancel to abort.
— Links last about 15 days and auto-renew every time you open the app (with a notice). Republishing the same project on the same machine overwrites the old link; another machine reusing the name gets its own link, no overwrites.
— Manage your machine's links in Browse projects → Links button: check expiry, renew, copy, open, delete. Expired links show a friendly page with a copy button to ask the creator for renewal.
help.sections.preview_export.subtitle: Test and share your game
help.sections.preview_export.title: Preview & Export
help.sections.templates.content:
📄 Question templates

Fill the sample table so the app understands questions, right answers and explanations — near-100% recognition.

📄 Steps
1. Get it: editor → left → purple Import → Download template → save it.
2. Word: columns Question, Options A–D, Correct answer, Explanation — one row per question.
3. Excel: same columns (STT, Question, Answer 1–4); the type is detected from your content.
4. Import: back in Import → pick your filled file → check the list → Import.
Millionaire note: Excel has only 2 guide items; Word supports multiple-choice and true/false.
help.sections.templates.title: Templates
help.sections.tools.content:
🧰 In-app tools

Small built-ins beyond editing: Edubot, calculator, quick find, screenshots, backups.

🧰 Tools
1. Edubot (AI): purple 💬 bottom-right — create/edit/delete questions, change time/points, find images. See Edubot.
2. Calculator: Ctrl+T → type expression (x for *, : for /) → Enter. Or ask Edubot “calculate 12*8+5”.
3. Quick find: Ctrl+K → type the task → Enter.
4. Screenshot: Home or left menu → Screenshot.
5. Backup: tell Edubot “backup project” to keep a portable .eduplay file.
help.sections.tools.title: Tools
help.sections.troubleshooting.content:
🔧 Troubleshooting

90% of issues are below — each fixed in a minute.

🔧 Fixes
1. Edubot silent: Edubot needs internet — check wifi, wait a few seconds, resend. Still stuck? Reopen the app.
2. Import finds nothing: fill the template (via Download template), one question per row, Save the file before importing.
3. Exported HTML is blank: export again into a simple folder (e.g. D:\Lessons, avoid very long paths or odd characters), open with Chrome.
🔧 More fixes
4. No HTML Frame button in PowerPoint: reinstall via Settings → Add-ons → Install, click Allow if asked, then close and reopen PowerPoint.
5. App feels slow: images under 1MB each, split 50+ question games, restart the app.
6. Still stuck: email support@eduplay-studio.io.vn with a screenshot of the error.
help.sections.troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
help.sections.tutorial.content:
🎓 End-to-end tutorial

First time? Follow these 5 stages to ship one complete game — no other page needed.

🎓 Stages
Stage 1 — Create: Home → CREATE NEW → name, description → pick a game type → Create & Edit. (See Create Project)
Stage 2 — Write: left → + Add → middle: question, answers, tick the right one, explanation → Save. Make 5–10. (See Edit Questions)
Stage 3 — Test: blue Preview, play like a student. Fix what is wrong. (See Preview & Export)
Stage 4 — Share: orange Export internal (HTML) for a .html file, or blue Publish to web for a link → send via Zalo/class group.
Stage 5 — Level up: Edubot bulk questions, Word/Excel import, PowerPoint insert.

help.sections.browse.content:
📁 Browse projects — find and manage

Every game you create lives here.

🔍 Search & filter
– Find fast: type in the search box on top — the list filters as you type.
– Filter by game type: All / Quiz / Millionaire / Fishing / Adventure, plus tag filter.
🗂️ Manage
– Each card has: Open (edit), Duplicate (copy), Rename, Edit tags, Delete (asks first) and creation date.
– More buttons: Refresh reloads the list, Import project opens a .eduplay file from another PC.

help.sections.export.content:
📤 Publish — send games to students

Three ways: HTML file, web link, PowerPoint.

📄 HTML file (plays offline)
Editor → top-right → orange Export internal (HTML) → choose folder → Save → send the .html via Zalo/Email/class group. Opens in Chrome, no install needed.
🔗 Web link (easiest)
Editor → blue Publish to web → wait → Game Links window → Copy the Public play link → send it. Students need internet. Links last about 15 days; republishing overwrites the old link.
📊 PowerPoint
PowerPoint: export HTML first, then PowerPoint → Insert → EduPlay group → HTML Frame → pick the .html. Details in PowerPoint Add-in.
help.sections.faq.subtitle: Quick answers
help.sections.import.content:
📥 Import questions from Word / Excel

Have questions in a file? Let the app split them automatically. Use the template for best results.

📄 Steps
1. Open Import: editor → left panel → purple Import.
2. Get the template (first time): click Download template → fill it: Word has Question, Options A–D, Correct answer, Explanation; Excel has STT, Question, Answer 1–4, Explanation (the type is detected from your content). Save the file.
3. Import: choose the .docx / .doc / .pdf / .xlsx / .txt → check the found questions → Import.
📐 Math brackets
Brackets [...] with math (e.g. [x+1]) stay literal text, not blanks; use double brackets [[x+1]] to force a blank.
Millionaire templates: Excel has only 2 guide items; Word supports multiple-choice and true/false; neither has the Note section.
help.sections.media.content:
🖼️ Media library — images, sounds, animations

Built-in assets to make questions lively. Your files are stored in the project media folder.

🖼️ Steps
1. Open Library: editor → left panel → Library tab.
2. Attach: while editing a question → Choose image / Choose audio → pick a file → Save question.
3. Ask Edubot: “add an image to question 3” — Edubot finds a suitable image and attaches it (needs Allow image download in Settings → AI).
⚠ Note
Keep images reasonable — huge images make the exported HTML heavy. The exported file already contains everything, so 1 file is enough to send.
help.sections.performance.subtitle: Tips to run smooth
help.sections.preview.content:
👀 Preview & playtest

Test as you write: one question, the whole game, or full-screen.

👀 Three ways
1. Quick view (1 question): editor → Preview Selected (eye) — shows only the selected question, handy right after editing it.
2. Full preview: top → blue Preview — play the whole game inside the app.
3. Full-screen play: Home → Play → pick a game. 4. Right live panel: the editor right column previews the question — click Refresh if it looks stale.
help.sections.settings.content:
⚙️ Settings

Gear button top-right: language, theme, autosave, game defaults, AI and the PowerPoint add-in.

⚙️ Tabs
1. General: language (VI/EN/FR/ES/DE), light/dark theme, autosave (on/off + interval), notifications, font size.
2. Editor: font family and size for writing questions.
3. Default game: default time, shuffle on/off, points, show explanations — applied to new projects.
4. AI (Edubot): turn on Allow internet for web lookup, Allow image download for auto-attached images.
5. Add-ons: check the PowerPoint inserter → Install / Open folder. If Windows asks, click Allow.
help.sections.shortcuts.content:
⌨️ Shortcuts & speed tips

A few keys and tricks to work twice as fast.

⌨️ Keys
Ctrl+K quick find • Ctrl+T calculator (x for *, : for /)• F5 slideshow.
💡 Tips
1: Hover the left edge for the side menu.
2: Drag the purple 💬 chat button anywhere.
3: Save each question right away.
4: Forgot a button? Ctrl+K and type what you want.

help.sections.tips.content:
💡 Hidden tips

⌨️ Editor shortcuts
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y (or Ctrl+Shift+Z) undo/redo everything while editing. Ctrl+K quick-searches everything.
🔗 Web links
Links last ~15 days and auto-renew when you open the app; check/renew manually in Browse projects → Links. Republishing on the same machine overwrites the old link. Name your machine in Settings to tell links apart.
💾 Never lose work
Every save keeps 5 backups in the project's backups folder; corrupted files auto-restore. Project names are unique per machine; copies/imports auto-number as (2).
👁️ Smart preview
The eye (Quick view) tests one question; Preview runs the whole game. Click a question image to zoom, ✕/Esc to close.
📥 Fast import
Import from Word/Excel in the editor (Import button) with a Download sample button. Combine jobs in one Edubot message.
🧠 Edubot remembers you
Say “my name is An, I teach math” once and later answers fit better. Say “clear memory” to forget everything.
⚠ If the app quits suddenly
Open crash.log in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EduPlayStudio\logs (Settings → Open log folder) to see the error. Drag the purple 💬 button elsewhere so it never covers your work.
